title: Daynori Production-Focused Security and Privacy Review and Vulnerability Remediation of the Enabled Web Core

auditedDimensions.mechanism: Every API route, object, job, and search result validates membership via app.user_has_workspace_role() and withTenantContext(). Cross-tenant access fails with 404/403.
Strict Zod schemas on all params, queries, and bodies. Parameterized SQL queries ($1, $2) throughout. 1 MiB bodyLimit in Fastify. sanitizeRequestId() enforces /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.

Two-phase upload reservation and finalization. Quarantine status enforced: getFileDownloadCapability strictly requires quarantineStatus === 'verified' (pending/quarantined files throw 409). Signed download capabilities expire in 300s.
JwtVerifier validates RS256/ES256 signatures, issuer, audience, and exp. Revoked tokens recorded in app.revoked_tokens via SHA-256 hash are immediately rejected with HTTP 401 TOKEN_REVOKED.
ProcessLocalRateLimiter sliding window (60 req/min) keyed by verified actor.userId or IP. Returns X-RateLimit-* headers and Retry-After on 429.
unresolvedRisks: In a multi-instance production cluster, process-local rate limiters operate independently per node; centralized Redis rate limiting is recommended for > 1,000 MAU.

auditedDimensions.mechanism: pnpm audit identified GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw (critical Next.js SVG Image Optimization RCE). Remediated by configuring images.unoptimized = true in apps/web/next.config.mjs, completely disabling the vulnerable optimization handler. Mobile dev-dependency node-forge vulnerabilities in Expo CLI triaged (mobile app is gated from web core release).
unresolvedRisks: Expo CLI / node-forge transitive vulnerabilities in apps/mobile remain pending Expo SDK 53 upgrade.

auditedDimensions.mechanism: Zero secrets in Git or logs. Fastify raw logger disabled. SafeLogger recursively redacts sensitive keys (password, token, secret, journal, body, prompt) and headers (authorization, cookie, x-api-key). sanitizeLogString redacts JWTs and postgres connection URLs with passwords.

Full lifecycle: request, confirmation token check, initiating session hash check, cancellation deadline. Relational purge deletes workspaces, memberships, devices, push subscriptions, AI index chunks, and records account and workspace tombstones in app.deletion_suppression_ledger.

Disaster recovery protocol (docs/engineering/backup-and-recovery.md Section 4.2) verified with dual-role pooler validation and pre-access deletion suppression barrier (restored database cannot revive purged accounts).

Global Fastify onRequest hook immediately rejects /v1/vault, /v1/ai, /v1/rooms, and /v1/billing with HTTP 403 Forbidden before router matching. Voice and Drive fail safe with missing credential/permission errors.
